The '''battlebird''' was a type of bird that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Orimanther]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Phylus Mon]] traveled to Orimanther and attempted to capture a flock of battlebirds. However, he was initially unsuccessful, so he meditated and attempted to use a [[Force storm (weather)|Force storm]] to knock the birds out of the sky.
